test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. ****Select the option that contains an error.**

The students were able to get better from college early so they went to the movies.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **to get better from**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase '**to get better from**' is incorrect. The correct phrase is '**to get back from**'.
 
• '**Get back**' means to return or come back from a place. (किसी स्थान से लौटना या वापस आना)
 
• '**Get better**' means the process of improving one's health, well-being, or condition, especially after an illness or injury, which is inappropriate in the context of the given sentence. (किसी के स्वास्थ्य, कल्याण या स्थिति में सुधार की प्रक्रिया, विशेषकर किसी बीमारी या चोट के बाद)
 
• The sentence should read: *The students were able to get back from college early so they went to the movies.*

Therefore, the correct answer is** option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**went to the movies**' is grammatically correct and makes sense in the context of the sentence.
 
• '**The students were able**' is grammatically correct and sets up the rest of the sentence.
 
• '**college early so they**' is grammatically correct and provides the reason for the student's actions.
